# Nexscope Ecommerce AI Tools

> Official Nexscope learning library with ecommerce guides, comparisons, case studies, trend analysis, and documented API evidence.

Canonical section: https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/
Language: English

## Core guides

- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/ecommerce-mcp-server/ — connect marketplace research APIs to AI agents with MCP
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/ecommerce-api-for-ai-agents/ — Amazon demand, competitor, keyword, and review APIs for agents
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/what-is-an-mcp-server/ — MCP concepts, clients, servers, tools, resources, and permissions
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/api-capabilities/ — ecommerce API capabilities and evidence boundaries
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/amazon-competitor-keyword-research/ — competitor keyword research workflow
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/amazon-negative-review-analysis/ — customer complaint and review analysis
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/website-seo-audit-guide/ — ecommerce page SEO audit
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/ai-video-generator/ — AI product-video workflow
- https://learn.nexscope.ai/ecommerce-ai-tools/ai-product-image-generator/ — AI product-image workflow

## Editorial and evidence policy

Pages distinguish observed test results, vendor-documented capabilities, provider estimates, proposed workflows, and unknown values. Product coverage, availability, freshness, authentication, and credit requirements can change. Use the linked official documentation as the source of truth before production use.
